subject: Launch day, 26 Aug
title: *Fifty-two minutes* on the wrong RPC.
standfirst: Records what happened on the morning of the Atlas launch, why the release pointed at the testnet, and the three actions that close the gap.

blocks.body: At 09:00 UTC the release build went live in both stores with the testnet RPC in its configuration. Balances showed as zero for every user who updated. No funds were at risk; 52 minutes of a wallet that looked empty, one hotfix, and a store review that was faster than we deserved.

blocks.source: Times in UTC, from the launch channel log.

rows: Release live; first reports of zero balances
Config diff read; testnet RPC confirmed
Hotfix built from the release branch, config only
Expedited review requested in both stores
Hotfix live; balances correct; incident closed

bullets: One configuration file for two environments
The testnet value had been committed for the beta and never reverted; the build did not know which environment it was for.
No check on the release build
The release checklist verified the version and the signing, not the network the app would talk to.

blocks.source: Tracked in Linear, ATL-140 to ATL-142.

rows: Environment baked at build time, one file per target
Release checklist: a mainnet balance read from the release build
Launch-day rota with a named person in each store console
